scope: full astronaut delivery: suit and indoor variants, 24 clips, rated from zero

fixes_optional: Leg and pelvis shading: better than round 1 but grey AO smudges remain on the front of the thighs and the lower torso (art/critic/r3_side_by_side.png). Clamp AO on SuitMain to >= 0.65 or blur the bake 2 more passes.
Gloves: still a block with a thumb. Split the index finger from the other three (8-sided, rounded tip); the carry grip and the console pose read better with it.
Shoulder plates (SuitHard): 1 cm bevel on the outer edges; now they read as flat boxes in the 3/4 views.
Pack lights at game size: the amber light does not show at 55 px (turnaround 55 px view); make both lenses 3 cm and emissive 4.
repair_kneel: the visor comes within a few cm of the machine face (clips_suit.png, repair_kneel 0-90). Lean the chest back 6-8 deg and extend the forearms so the helmet keeps >= 8 cm clear.

fixes: Face: the nose is not small; it is a large wedge that projects about as far as the brow and reads as a beak in every 3/4 view (art/critic/r3_in_face.png). Reduce its projection by 40%, round the tip, widen the nostril base 10%. Add a mouth (a 3 cm soft line, lip colour 10% darker than Skin) and a slightly rounder jaw. Eyes: one step larger with an upper-lid line; lower the brow lines 3 mm and curve them so the face reads calm, not stern.
Head and neck: widen the skull 6-8% and shorten the visible neck by 3 cm, thicken it 15%. Now the head sits on a long thin post (r3_side_by_side.png).

Hair variants at game size: at 55 px all four heads look the same (art/critic/r3_in_55.png), not only crop and bob. Give each a different silhouette: crop tight to the skull; bob to the jaw with +2 cm volume at the sides; bun +35% and set higher; ponytail longer (to the collar) and swinging out 3 cm. If the game allows it, tint hair per colonist from 4 colours (black, dark brown, auburn, dark blonde): colour does more at 55 px than shape.

Body mass: the limbs are thin next to the suit and the figure reads as a mannequin. Upper arms and thighs +12-15% girth, forearms and calves +8%. Raise the crotch 4 cm; the jumpsuit seat hangs low in the front view.
Shoulder panels: round the outer corners with a 1.5 cm bevel and let the panel follow the shoulder curve; they read as flat plates.
Hands: the open hand is a mitten with a thumb that sticks out (deform_indoor.png 'hand'). Separate the index finger, curl the rest 20 deg in the relaxed pose, bring the thumb in 15 deg.

Detail density: the suit has many parts; the jumpsuit has a zip line, two pocket flaps and a belt. Add a name patch with the role accent on the chest, a sleeve patch, seam lines on the sides of the legs, and a small wrist unit (Screen material) so it matches the suit's level of detail.
Evidence: show the 6 skin tones in turnaround_indoor.png (one row, 55 px and close). Nothing shows them now.

Contract gate (V3 3.5): godot_check.json is ok false with 28 failures (14 per variant). The pass is provisional until it is ok true. The failures: every stand loop <-> work_console / work_bench / talk change pops hand.L or hand.R 29-46 deg at blend frame 5; carry on/off pops prop.R 80.5 deg; idle -> walk -> run -> stop pops shin.L 39.5 deg (limit 36.5). A 0.25 s cross-fade of a 45 deg difference is about 6 deg per frame, so a 35-46 deg step means the blend is not applied to the hand bones at that frame: RENDER. ART-NPC can help: bring the hand rest orientation of work_console and work_bench within 20 deg of idle so a blend never has to cover 45 deg.
carry on/off: prop.R should not rotate 80 deg. Keep prop.R at the same local rotation in idle, walk, carry_idle and carry_walk; move the crate with the hand bone, not by turning prop.R.
repair_kneel: helmet clearance to the machine face (see npc_suit optional fix 5). The same clip on the indoor variant has the head 15 cm closer to the panel than is natural; lean back 6-8 deg.
sit_eat on the suit variant brings the glove to the closed visor. RENDER must show eating only on the indoor variant (the suit variant uses sit_idle or sit_type in a mess hall).
talk: the gestures are small at game size (talk 0-90 in both sheets). Raise the gesturing forearm 15 deg higher at the peak and add a 10 deg head nod.
carry_walk: the arms are locked straight for the whole loop. Add 5 deg of elbow give on each foot strike.

Suited sleepers: the suit sinks 3.2 cm into the mattress in sleep (npc_report info line). Suited colonists do not use beds, so RENDER must never play lie_enter / sleep / lie_exit on the suit variant; put that rule in the RENDER state machine and its check.

The face, the long thin neck, the thin limbs and the four identical-looking heads hold it down. At the game camera the body works; close up in a room (where Paul will look at people in beds and at tables) the face lets it down.
